accepted_scope_caveats.label: honest_scope / entire proposal
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The causal reading requires an application-specific restricted single-NCO submodel whose relevant bridge belongs to the user-chosen class H_beta(R,eta); neither bridge membership nor causal identification is claimed from nonrejection.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The headline contribution is testing and bounding the observed-law defect d(P); rejection has causal-falsification force only conditionally on that restricted submodel.
